MRI Safety Information
The Willow Coronary Stent System is MR Conditional. A person with the Willow Coronary Stent System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Willow Coronary Stent System
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 T
RF Receive Coil Type Any
RF Conditions Maximum Whole-Body SAR 0.4 W/kg
Scan Duration Maximum active scan time of 10 minutes.
Image Artifact The image artifact extends approximately 10 mm from the device.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
